questions.name: category
questions.instructions: What kind of email is this, for the person who received it?

choices.description: Written personally by a friend, family member, partner or acquaintance
About a job, internship, freelance work, a client or a colleague, including work meetings and invitations
Official and life paperwork: university or school, government, taxes, insurance, health, housing, landlord, utilities, legal, bank, bills, invoices, payments, refunds
Purchase receipts, order confirmations, shipping and delivery updates, subscription renewals
Login alerts, verification codes, password resets, account security notices
Automated notifications from social networks, forums, chat, gaming or developer platforms, and event invitations from them
Newsletters, digests, blogs or updates the person subscribed to read
Marketing, promotions, sales, discounts or product advertising
Unsolicited junk, scams, phishing or mail from unknown senders with no legitimate purpose

questions.name: needs_reply
questions.instructions: The sender expects a written reply from the recipient.

questions.name: needs_action
questions.instructions: The recipient has to do something because of this email (pay, sign, confirm, book, attend, submit, fix), beyond just reading it.

questions.name: has_deadline
questions.instructions: The email mentions a specific date or time by which the recipient must act or respond.

questions.name: written_by_person
questions.instructions: The email was written individually by a human for this recipient, not generated automatically or sent in bulk.

questions.name: suspicious
questions.instructions: The email looks like phishing, a scam, or an attempt to trick the recipient into giving credentials, money or clicking a malicious link.

questions.name: urgency
questions.instructions: How soon does the recipient need to deal with this email?

levels.label: this_week
levels.description: Should be handled within a few days
